en: Vintage monochrome postcard with a photograph on the left of a small church with a bell tower and arched doorway, surrounded by trees. On the right is printed Spanish text describing the church, titled "IGLESIA DE SANTA SUSANA (SANTIAGO DE COMPOSTELA)." At the bottom left of the image area appears the credit "Biblioteca de Galicia." The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
